messages:
alex: Quick heads-up — PR #4327 (migration-guide: v2 SDK) is sitting unreviewed in the release queue, blocking the docs merge window.

tara: Link to PR?

alex: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4327

sam-docs-bot: CI preview failed — linkcheck error in section 'Upgrading from v1'

jen: I can take a look, looks small. If it's just a broken anchor I can fix + re-run preview. @alex assign to me?

mike: Prefer SDK team own the migration guide review, but ok if jen can unblock for this release. We should mark it as 'post-release followup' if SDK does full pass later.

alex: Thanks. Assigning now and kicking off a preview rebuild. Command I used:
```
gh pr edit 4327 --add-label docs-review-needed && gh pr review 4327 --request
```

tara: FYI, local linkcheck:
```
make -C docs linkcheck
# or: mkdocs build && mkdocs serve
```

jen: fixed the anchor and one sample code snippet, pushed patch. Re-running preview now :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam-docs-bot: Preview succeeded — checks green ✅

alex: Great — merging at the 16:00 docs merge window unless anyone objects. Also propose small change to reviewer flow: add 'docs-review-needed' label + auto-assign to docs-rotation if no reviewer within 24h. Thoughts?

mike: +1 to auto-assign. Maybe make it only for <500 loc PRs.

tara: +1. Can we get a tiny GH Action to ping on 12h then auto-assign? :thinking:

jen: fine with that, will add a checklist item on PR template reminding SDK owners for migration guides.

alex: Awesome. Merging now. :thumbsup:
